title: Cold
html:
For other possible meanings of Cold in the game, see:  Cold (disambiguation)

⁠Cold is one of the damage types in the game.

  • For all sources of Cold, see Category:Sources of Cold damage.
  • For creatures weak to Cold, see Category:Vulnerable to Cold.
  • For creatures resistant to Cold, see Category:Resistant to Cold.
  • For creatures immune to Cold, see Category:Immune to Cold.

Sources of Cold damage

The following sections list various ways in which a player character, or creatures they summon, can deal Cold damage.

Special actions, spells, etc. that are exclusively accessible to non-player characters are not listed.

Spells

  •  Armour of Agathys
  •  Chromatic Orb: Cold
  •  Cone of Cold
  •  Fire Shield: Chill
  •  Glyph of Warding: Cold
  •  Hunger of Hadar
  •  Ice Knife
  •  Ice Storm
  •  Otiluke's Conveniently Portable Freezing Sphere
  •  Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
  •  Otiluke's Freezing Sphere (Launch)
  •  Ray of Frost
  •  Wall of Ice

Class actions

  •  Blade of Rime
  •  Chill of the Mountain
  •  Sphere of Elemental Balance: Cold

Special actions

  •  Divine Strike: Cold (Melee)
  •  Divine Strike: Cold (Ranged)
  •  Elemental Cleaver (cold)
  •  Explosive Icicle
  •  Frigid Blade
  •  Frost Breath
  •  Hiemal Strike
  •  Multiattack (Water Elemental)
  •  Slam (Water Elemental)

Weapons

The following weapons deal Cold damage as part of their regular attacks.

  •  Allandra's Whelm - inaccessible
  •  Cold Snap
  •  Mourning Frost
  •  Trident of the Depths - inaccessible
  •  Wavemother's Sickle

Consumables

The following consumable items can be used to deal Cold damage. In the case of arrows, the damage is in addition to the attacker's regular ranged weapon damage.

  •  Arrow of Ice: Deal +2d4⁠⁠Cold in an area.  DEX Save (DC 12) to negate.

Interactions

  •  Snowburst Ring: Upon dealing cold damage, create  Ice around the target.
  •  Winter's Clutches: Upon dealing cold damage, inflict  Encrusted with Frost.
  •  Robe of Summer,  Icebite Robe, and  Wavemother's Robe: Gain resistance to cold.
  •  Necklace of Elemental Augmentation: When dealing cold damage with a cantrip, adds the spellcasting modifier to the damage.
  •  Mourning Frost: When dealing ⁠Cold damage, the wielder deals an additional 1⁠⁠Cold.
  • Wet surfaces such as  Water,  Oil,  Acid, etc. temporarily become  Ice upon receiving cold damage, but it always melts back into  Water.
